title: Metering Service Rule on Late Payment Charges in Referee Refund Settlements
content:
Late payment charges posted on the Electric Service Agreement within the whole calendar months a **Metering Service** referee refund settlement reprices, counted from the handling date as the repriced bills are, were computed on overstated bills, and the settlement reprices them according to the agreement's schedule.

- **General service.** Where the agreement is on a general service schedule (GS, GST, GD or LP) and such late payment charges exist, the repriced late payment charges are those charges times the referee refund error factor, rounded to the cent.
- **Residential.** Where the agreement is on a residential schedule (RS, RT or REV) and such late payment charges exist, the repriced late payment charges are all of those charges.
- **None posted.** Where no late payment charge was posted within those months, no late payment charge is repriced.

The months are the same span of months, reckoned back from the handling date, that selects the repriced bills.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Schedule | Late payment charges in the repriced months | Referee refund error factor | Repriced late payment charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| GST | 18.40 | 0.0243902 | 18.40 times 0.0243902, rounded: 0.45 |
| REV | 18.40 | 0.0243902 | 18.40, in full |
| LP | None | Any | None |
